summary: This note is a Wikipedia infobox-style extract about Ariana Grande's 2017 digital single "Somewhere Over the Rainbow." one_line: Ariana Grande's 2017 pop digital single cover of "Somewhere Over the Rainbow," released June 6, 2017 on Republic Records.
